name: Boris Ashirbaevich KOZHEVNIKOV

Valizer, as the head of the penal colony, is responsible for that facility’s policy towards Gorinov.

The Memorial “Support for Political Prisoners” programme recognised him as a political prisoner. Kriger was put in solitary confinement for a period of 90 days and was not allowed to have visits from relatives or to receive letters from outside the penal colony. As a consequence, Kriger went on a hunger strike for 51 days.
